summary: Iteration 4 tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 11/11 pass covering: seeded flour types & Packing Bags, GET/PUT /api/settings (washed_loss/unwashed_loss/starting_cash persist), customer ledger (grinding debit + partial credit + running balance where balance=debits-credits), auto-credit on Paid sale (outstanding stays 0), PATCH /grinding/{id}/pay creates single credit (no double-count on second call — verified by ref_id lookup), supplier ledger auto-credit on paid purchase (outstanding=0), /api/cashbook returns opening/received/supplier/expenses/closing with correct math and starting_cash effect, /api/sales-analytics returns today/month/year + top(<=5)/least + profit, /api/audit logs stock change entries, low-stock notifications fire for new products. Frontend E2E: green/gold theme confirmed (--primary 123 46% 34%, --secondary 43 81% 46%, Inter font), sidebar has Reports & Settings, Reports page shows rep-today/month/year/profit + cashbook-card + top-N/least-N tables, Settings page saves loss% + starting cash with audit log table populated, Customers page ledger dialog opens & Record Payment updates ledger + toast, Suppliers page ledger dialog opens, Production page contains Sattu.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: ledgerFor is not defined – missing useState declaration for ledgerFor/setLedgerFor, page crashed entirely (blank + error overlay). FIXED by adding const [ledgerFor, setLedgerFor] = useState(null).

action_items: Customers.js had leftover unused hist/setHist/histName state (from removed history dialog); consider cleaning up.
server.py is now ~1200 lines — split into routers per resource (auth, products, sales, ledger, cashbook, analytics, audit) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: Customers.js used setLedgerFor without declaring the state variable — caught by React runtime. This should have been caught in E1's smoke run. Consider adding a lint rule (no-undef) and a build-time check before shipping.

log_audit is inconsistent: sales & purchases & production log audit, but grinding, oil, expenses, payments (via /payments), and product delete/update stock delta all mostly log — however edit endpoints (PUT /sales/{id}, PUT /grinding/{id}, PUT /oil/{id}, PUT /expenses/{id}) do NOT emit audit entries even though they mutate finances. Add log_audit calls to edits & deletes for completeness.
cashbook opening derivation iterates ALL payments/expenses and filters by date string; scale concern >10-20k rows. Consider a mongodb aggregation pipeline with date index.

sales-analytics computes profit using product's current cost_per_unit at query time, not the cost at sale time — historical profit will silently drift as new purchases update WACC. Snapshot cost_per_unit on each sale row for accurate historical margin.
PATCH /purchases/{id}/pay does not update the corresponding invoice payment_status (unlike sales/grinding/oil in mark_paid). Minor inconsistency.
All list endpoints still use .to_list(1000-5000) without pagination — silent truncation at scale.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 features fully verified. Fixed Customers.js missing useState for ledgerFor. Backend regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (11 tests). Prior iteration tests test_agrimill.py, test_mill_expansion.py, test_iteration3.py are still in tree.
rca of the issue: Frontend Customers page rendered nothing due to ReferenceError: ledgerFor is not defined at Customers.js:71 — LedgerDialog integration added references to ledgerFor/setLedgerFor but forgot the useState hook. Fixed by declaring const [ledgerFor, setLedgerFor] = useState(null) alongside the existing state at the top of the component. After fix, ledger buttons render, dialog opens, Record Payment records payment via POST /api/payments and refreshes ledger + toast displays.
